'''Reeho stew''' was a type of [[Stew/Legends|stew]]. It was cooked by the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustans]] living at [[Krevk Settlement]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gelgelar/Legends|Gelgelar]]. The primary ingredient was the [[Reeho (bird)|reeho]], a [[Bird/Legends|bird]] native to the world. Preparation for the stew included heating up [[levsh oil]] in a pan.<ref name="BG" />
